description: Secretaria Municipal de Assistência e Desenvolvimento Social (SMADS), City of São Paulo publishes a database of the facilities of the municipal social assistance secretariat, prepared by its geoprocessing centre from information supplied by the facilities themselves, published as 22 files with a yearly version from 2005; the page carries a discontinuation notice saying the last available version is from 2014. Coverage: the municipality of São Paulo, 2005 to 2014; the portal record was modified on 2026-07-28. Format and access: CSV, XLS, downloadable without registration from the São Paulo municipal open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the dataset is discontinued; columns, counts and coordinates were not opened and the facility types are not listed on the page; the portal has a separate series on occupancy rates of the assistance services. Simulation uses: historical layers of shelters and social-service facilities for vulnerability, accessibility and emergency-shelter capacity studies. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
